prompt: automatically review if the payment is over 500 USD
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 500 THEN REVIEW reason="high_amount"

prompt: automatically allow if the payment is under 5 USD
rule: WHEN txn.amount < 5 THEN ALLOW reason="low_amount"

prompt: Block payments made from a location or card issued outside your country
rule: WHEN txn.is_international THEN BLOCK reason="international"

prompt: Identify and block transactions exceeding 100,000 made through credit card payments to prevent potential fraud.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 100000 AND txn.method == CARD THEN BLOCK reason="card_high_amount"

prompt: Prevent excessive transaction attempts by blocking any card with more than ten attempts within one hour
rule: WHEN txn.method == CARD AND txn.count_1h > 10 THEN BLOCK reason="card_velocity"

prompt: Decline transactions when the amount exceeds USD 100 per transaction.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 100 THEN BLOCK reason="amount_limit"

prompt: amount > 5000 AND device_age_days < 1 AND country != user_home_country → route_to_review
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 5000 AND device.age_days < 1 AND txn.is_international THEN REVIEW reason="new_device_abroad"

prompt: Review all payments greater than US$1,000 that were made with a card
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 1000 AND txn.method == CARD THEN REVIEW reason="card_high_amount"

prompt: Block card payments of more than $1000.
rule: WHEN txn.method == CARD AND txn.amount > 1000 THEN BLOCK reason="card_high_amount"

prompt: Decline international transactions when the amount exceeds EUR 5000.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.amount > 5000 THEN BLOCK reason="international_limit"

prompt: Decline payments except for grocery stores and restaurants.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.category IN [GROCERY, FOOD] THEN BLOCK reason="category_limit"

prompt: Decline transactions when three failed payment attempts occur within 24 hours.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 3 THEN BLOCK reason="failed_attempts"

prompt: Block payments above 50,000 from new customers paying by card.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 50000 AND user.account_age_days < 30 AND txn.method == CARD THEN BLOCK reason="new_customer_card"

prompt: Automatically block any transaction exceeding 2,500 EUR.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 2500 THEN BLOCK reason="high_amount"

prompt: If the order exceeds $500 and the customer account is less than 24 hours old, decline the transaction.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 500 AND user.account_age_days < 1 THEN BLOCK reason="new_account_amount"

prompt: Flag orders placed between 2-4 AM for review.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 2 AND txn.hour < 4 THEN REVIEW reason="night_orders"
alt: WHEN txn.hour >= 2 AND txn.hour <= 4 THEN REVIEW reason="night_orders"

prompt: Flag transactions involving electronics.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == ELECTRONICS THEN REVIEW reason="electronics"

prompt: If the transaction amount is ≥ ₹50,000, then block further transactions.
rule: WHEN txn.amount >= 50000 THEN BLOCK reason="high_amount"

prompt: Review payments of 10,000 or more.
rule: WHEN txn.amount >= 10000 THEN REVIEW reason="high_amount"

prompt: Hold UPI transfers above ₹10,000 for review.
rule: WHEN txn.method == UPI AND txn.amount > 10000 THEN REVIEW reason="upi_cooling_off"
